title: Failing agent test, then run a cached config of the previous protocol
goal: An upgraded agent keeps running its cached schedules with no hub
acceptance: An agent test, committed failing first: a cached config of the previous protocol is used with its new fields at their defaults and schedules run with no hub
A config of a newer or unknown protocol is still refused with a fault
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-26: parseCachedConfig (packages/contracts/src/mqtt.ts) runs a cached config of the previous protocol with new fields at their defaults; a newer, unknown or unreadable cached config is refused with a config fault.
